reconcile.note: Adam Clarke glosses Exodus 4:22's firstborn as a title of endearment, not exclusive rank, letting Jeremiah, Romans, and Colossians reapply it to Ephraim and Jesus.

discrepancy.emptyNote: Steve Wells's Skeptic's Annotated Bible lists Israel, Ephraim, and Jesus as three incompatible answers to who God's firstborn son actually is.

sides.snippet: Israel is my son, my firstborn,
sides.verseText: You shall tell Pharaoh, 'Thus says Yahweh, Israel is my son, my firstborn,

sides.snippet: who is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn of all creation.
